title: Exactness of the Cech sequence of a module for a principal open covering
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $f_1,\dots,f_n\in R$ elements generating the unit ideal, and $M$ an $R$-module; write $M_{f}$ for the localization of $M$ at $f$ and $M_{f_i}\to M_{f_if_j}$, $M_{f_j}\to M_{f_if_j}$ for the canonical maps [def-weil-pbc-module-localization-away]. Then the sequence $0\to M\xrightarrow{\alpha}\bigoplus_{i=1}^nM_{f_i}\xrightarrow{\beta}\bigoplus_{i,j=1}^nM_{f_if_j}$ is exact, where $\alpha(m)=(m/1,\dots,m/1)$ and $\beta((m_i/f_i^{e_i})_i)=(m_i/f_i^{e_i}-m_j/f_j^{e_j})_{(i,j)}$ (the differences taken in $M_{f_if_j}$ via the canonical maps). That is: $m\in M$ with $m/1=0$ in every $M_{f_i}$ is $0$, and every family $(s_i)\in\prod_iM_{f_i}$ whose images in $M_{f_if_j}$ agree for all $i,j$ is $(m/1)_i$ for a (unique) $m\in M$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma 00EK (label lemma-cover-module) and its proof

proof.text: *Notation.* Write $\rho_{ij}:M_{f_i}\to M_{f_if_j}$, $x/f_i^e\mapsto f_j^ex/(f_if_j)^e$, and $\rho'_{ij}:M_{f_j}\to M_{f_if_j}$, $x/f_j^e\mapsto f_i^ex/(f_if_j)^e$, for the canonical maps (the unique $R$-linear maps sending $x/1$ to $x/1$) [def-weil-pbc-module-localization-away]; so $\beta((s_i)_i)=(\rho_{ij}(s_i)-\rho'_{ij}(s_j))_{(i,j)}$. Recall from the definition: every element of $M_f$ is $x/f^e$ for some $x\in M$, $e\ge0$; $x/f^e=x'/f^e$ iff $f^k(x-x')=0$ for some $k\ge0$; and $x/f^e=f^cx/f^{e+c}$. Both $\alpha$ and $\beta$ are $R$-linear. *$\beta\alpha=0$:* $\rho_{ij}(m/1)=m/1=\rho'_{ij}(m/1)$ in $M_{f_if_j}$, so the $(i,j)$-component of $\beta(\alpha(m))$ is $0$.

source.place: Lemma 00EK (label lemma-cover-module); direct argument written by the agent (the Stacks proof localizes at maximal ideals instead)

proof.text: *Exactness at $M$ ($\alpha$ injective).* Let $m\in M$ with $m/1=0$ in $M_{f_i}$ for all $i$. The set $\{f_1,\dots,f_n\}$ generates the unit ideal, so $m=0$ by [lem-weil-pbc-localized-span-eq-zero]. (Directly: $m/1=0$ in $M_{f_i}$ gives $f_i^{k_i}m=0$; with $k=\max_ik_i$ we have $f_i^km=0$ for all $i$, and by [lem-weil-pbc-span-pow-eq-top] $1=\sum_ib_if_i^k$ for some $b_i\in R$, so $m=\sum_ib_if_i^km=0$.)

source.place: Lemma 00EK (label lemma-cover-module); direct argument written by the agent (the Stacks proof localizes at maximal ideals instead)

proof.text: *Exactness in the middle, a common denominator.* Let $(s_i)_i\in\bigoplus_iM_{f_i}$ with $\beta((s_i))=0$, i.e. $\rho_{ij}(s_i)=\rho'_{ij}(s_j)$ in $M_{f_if_j}$ for all $i,j$. Write $s_i=x_i/f_i^{e_i}$ with $x_i\in M$, $e_i\ge0$, put $N=\max_ie_i$ and $m_i=f_i^{N-e_i}x_i$. Then $s_i=m_i/f_i^N$ for every $i$ (multiply numerator and denominator by $f_i^{N-e_i}$).

source.place: Lemma 00EK (label lemma-cover-module); direct argument written by the agent (the Stacks proof localizes at maximal ideals instead)

proof.text: *Compatibility as an identity in $M$.* By the formulas for $\rho_{ij},\rho'_{ij}$, $\rho_{ij}(s_i)=f_j^Nm_i/(f_if_j)^N$ and $\rho'_{ij}(s_j)=f_i^Nm_j/(f_if_j)^N$. These two fractions with the same denominator are equal in $M_{f_if_j}$, so there is $k_{ij}\ge0$ with $(f_if_j)^{k_{ij}}(f_j^Nm_i-f_i^Nm_j)=0$. Put $K=\max_{i,j}k_{ij}$; then $(f_if_j)^K(f_j^Nm_i-f_i^Nm_j)=0$, i.e. $f_i^Kf_j^{N+K}m_i=f_i^{N+K}f_j^Km_j$, for all $i,j$.

source.place: Lemma 00EK (label lemma-cover-module); direct argument written by the agent (the Stacks proof localizes at maximal ideals instead)

proof.text: *Construction of the glued element.* By [lem-weil-pbc-span-pow-eq-top] (applied to $\{f_1,\dots,f_n\}$ and the exponent $N+K$) there are $a_1,\dots,a_n\in R$ with $\sum_ia_if_i^{N+K}=1$. Put $m=\sum_ia_if_i^Km_i\in M$. For each $j$, using step 4 in the third equality, $f_j^{N+K}m=\sum_ia_if_i^Kf_j^{N+K}m_i=\sum_ia_if_i^{N+K}f_j^Km_j=\bigl(\sum_ia_if_i^{N+K}\bigr)f_j^Km_j=f_j^Km_j$. Hence in $M_{f_j}$: $m/1=f_j^{N+K}m/f_j^{N+K}=f_j^Km_j/f_j^{N+K}=m_j/f_j^N=s_j$. So $\alpha(m)=(s_j)_j$: the kernel of $\beta$ is contained in the image of $\alpha$, and with $\beta\alpha=0$ (step 1) the sequence is exact at $\bigoplus_iM_{f_i}$.

source.place: Lemma 00EK (label lemma-cover-module); direct argument written by the agent (the Stacks proof localizes at maximal ideals instead)

proof.text: *Uniqueness.* If also $\alpha(m')=(s_j)_j$, then $(m-m')/1=0$ in every $M_{f_j}$, so $m=m'$ by step 2 ([lem-weil-pbc-localized-span-eq-zero]). Together, steps 1–5 give the exactness of $0\to M\to\bigoplus_iM_{f_i}\to\bigoplus_{i,j}M_{f_if_j}$, and step 6 is the uniqueness clause of the statement.
